title: DCML Harmony Payload
description: Columnar DCML harmony annotation labels from the 'expanded' facet of the Distant Listening Corpus (all descriptor columns from 'label' onwards, each as a parallel array).

label.description: String corresponding to the entire annotation label.

globalkey.description: The key of the entire piece as note name, lowercase designating a minor key.

localkey.description: The key that a Roman numeral is relative to, expressed as a Roman numeral relative to the global key.

pedal.description: Pedal point, specified as Roman numeral.

chord.description: The part of an annotation label that corresponds to the actual chord label.

special.description: Special labels such as "Fr6" or "Ger65" which are converted internally to Roman numerals.

numeral.description: The Roman numeral part of a DCML label, lowercase for all chords with a minor third.

figbass.description: Chord inversion: 7, 65, 43, 2, 64, 6 or empty for root position.

changes.description: Alterations, suspensions, additions, and omissions, written within parentheses in the chord label.

relativeroot.description: The Roman numeral following the / in applied chords. Can itself include a /. For example, V/V if the label pertains to the major scale on the second scale degree.

cadence.description: Cadence: PAC, IAC, EC, DC, PC, HC, and HC subtypes such as HC.SIM.

phraseend.description: The phrase annotation part of a DCML label, can be {, }, or }{.

globalkey_is_minor.description: Boolean that is 1 if the piece is in minor and 0 if it is in major.

localkey_is_minor.description: Boolean that is 1 if the local key is minor and 0 if it is major.

chord_tones.description: Tones expressed by the label, as fifth intervals relative to the local tonic. The datapackage descriptor declares strings, but dimcat materializes tuples of integers; BOPP stores them as variable-length integer arrays.

added_tones.description: Chord tones considered as added, expressed as fifth intervals relative to the local tonic. The datapackage descriptor declares strings, but dimcat materializes tuples of integers; BOPP stores them as variable-length integer arrays.

bass_note.description: Lowest note designated by the chord label, expressed as fifth intervals relative to the local tonic.

alt_label.description: Another interpretation of the same chord which the annotator finds equally or slightly less convincing.

volta.description: Number of an ending bracket, given as integer.

placement.description: Placement of the annotation label in the score (e.g. above/below).
